newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai car sales rise 3.1 percent in 1996 - Toyota.
newsitem.headline: Thai car sales rise 3.1 percent in 1996 - Toyota.

text.p: Sales of cars and commercial vehicles in Thailand roses 3.1 percent in 1996 to 589,126 units from 571,580 in the previous year, Toyota Motors (Thailand) said on Friday.
Vehicle sales this year are expected to be 625,000 units depending how quickly the slowing Thai economy recovers, Toyota said in a statement.
Passenger-car sales in 1996 grew 5.73 percent to 172,730 from 163,371 a year ago, Toyota said.
Total sales of commercial vehicles in the period was up 2.01 percent to 416,396 from 408,209 in 1995, it said.
Toyota was the top seller in the year with a 27.8 percent market share on sales of 163,940 units, up from 159,658 a year ago.
Isuzu was second with 122,044 sold in 1996, representing 20.7 percent share of the market, compared with 118,998 in the previous year.
Thailand's passenger car imports in 1996 fell 39 percent to 33,224 units from 54,819 in 1995, the customs department said in a statement on Friday.
Passenger cars from Europe topped the list with 16,176 brought into Thailand, representing 49 percent of total car import, the department said.
